title: Electronic medical record system
description: SMART Base's generic system persona DAK.Persona.System.EMR, one kind of the PHC handbook's person-centred point of service system (PCPOSS). It takes on the point-of-care-system role: it renders the DAK's forms and decision support, and records what the health worker accepts.

reference: who-iris library 9789240093362-eng (Digital transformation handbook for primary health care), sec-002-glossary (Person-centred point of service system; Electronic health record system)
